snippet.title: Lenin Street Geek Shop - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Lenin Street Geek Shop, a stylized shop-keeping management game developed by Perelesoq. Players will manage the day-to-day operations of a small snowy town's first geek shop, from stocking shelves, tending to customer needs, and growing the store. Lenin Street Geek Shop is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.


Check out the demo on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3225880/Lenin_Street_Geek_Shop/
